maddeler.e:
تعتاضوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَاضُوا (taʕtāḍū) /taʕ.taː.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
# تُعْتَاضُوا (tuʕtāḍū) /tuʕ.taː.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَاضَ (iʕtāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
